verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is fundamentally a chat-based AI assistant: users interact via natural-language messages across Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Slack, iMessage, etc., and the gateway interprets these into tool use, skills, automations, and multi-agent orchestration. Both first-party docs and community usage (e.g. 'running 9 agents from one machine' via chat commands) corroborate natural-language operation as the core interface. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review specifically praising NL command robustness/accuracy beyond anecdotal HN comments.
